areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Work hubs, vocational training and employment activities for people serving sentences, aimed at reducing reoffending.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Reoffending concentrated among Black people; planned empowerment and training for women and sexual-minority groups, and for those serving sentences and released.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Main problem is violence hitting vulnerable groups, notably young people, women and Black men, evidenced in the proposal.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Educational activities, classrooms, libraries, vocational courses and telemedicine/telepsychology offices in prison units.
